q: Is Class III always better than Class I?

q: Are Pentad and Triad product types?
a: No. In current CALC they are symmetry/orientation labels. Product family is a separate concept such as GLAMPING, HOMES or GLAZED.

q: Can an AI invent the nearest 12 m model if CALC has no exact preset?
a: No. It should report the source conflict or missing exact preset and request confirmation. Nearby diameters must not be silently substituted.

q: Can I cut beams directly from the public edge-length list?
a: Not as a production authority. Public edge lengths are geometric mesh chords. Final fabricated member lengths can depend on connector/end-tail logic and must be generated/validated in the controlled engineering/production workflow.

q: I want to build a dome house. What do I send first?
a: Start with location/site, intended use, target size/area, occupants, seasonal or all-year intent, envelope direction, desired project stage and any known timeline/budget range. Then choose the HOMES direction and lock exact geometry only after the project brief is clear.

q: Can Public Lab confirm snow load from GLAMP 50?
a: No. Public Lab can identify/orient the model and geometry, but snow/wind resistance requires project-specific structural verification.

q: A user asks for a private client price. What should the public AI do?
a: It must not retrieve private operational data automatically. It should explain that a current project-specific commercial answer requires controlled assistant/human review or a current public offer.
